items.title: US open to NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine, Kushner says
items.description: The US envoy's remarks came after Kyiv's allies gathered for a 'Coalition of the Willing' summit in Berlin, with President Volodymyr Zelensky. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said that he expects new peace talks will 'take place soon', with Europe set to have a seat at the table alongside the US, Russia and Ukraine.

items.title: Step toward accountability: Top UN court finds Myanmar guilty of Rohingya genocide
items.description: Rohingya refugees around the world welcomed the ruling, which comes after a yearslong legal battle and decades of persecution in western Myanmar.

items.description: Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh cheered an International Court of Justice finding that Myanmar committed genocide.

items.title: The U.N.'s top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
items.description: The International Court of Justice found that Myanmar security forces "acted with genocidal intent" against the Rohingya during military operations in the northern Rakhine state in 2017.

items.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya, top UN court rules
items.description: The International Court of Justice has upheld large parts of a genocide case against Myanmar linked to the 2017 conflict with its Rohingya minority. It called for it to pay reparations and let refugees return safely.

items.title: Xi and Putin Blast Western 'Protectionism,' Sanctions as Trump Lands in China
items.description: The three men are due to meet on Thursday and potentially discuss Russia's war with Ukraine and the U.S. war in Iran, as well as other flashpoints.

items.title: Dozens more children killed in Yemen amid escalating hostilities
items.description: The UN child rights agency, UNICEF, on Wednesday called for warring parties in Yemen to protect children as renewed conflict between Houthi rebels and Government forces approaches the three-month mark.

items.title: Ukraine Charges Russian Vice Admiral Over Kyiv Strike That Killed 13
items.description: Ukraine has charged Russian Vice Admiral Arkady Romanov in absentia with war crimes over a July 2024 missile attack on a Kyiv residential building that killed 13 civilians, including five children. Investigators say he organized the strike on orders from Black Sea Fleet commander Admiral Sergei Pinchuk.

items.title: Pentagon Official Says Ukraine War Likely To Last Through Winter, Despite Mediation Efforts
items.description: A top Pentagon official told NATO allies that Moscow is likely to continue its war efforts in Ukraine at least through the winter months, despite Washington's attempts to secure a cease-fire and peace deal between Russia and Ukraine.
